title: Explorer console
responsibility: Loads recorded repository revisions and supplies the selected explorer screen with navigation, entities and evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.base
inputs.description: Required URL prefix used for the history data client, media and selected screen addresses.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.path
inputs.description: Required address within the base, including any query string. Determines the selected branch, revision and screen.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.navigate
inputs.description: Required host callback receiving the next relative address and whether to replace browser history. Corrections replace history; user navigation normally adds an entry.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.links
inputs.description: Optional compatibility input; defaults to JavaScript undefined. It is neither read nor rendered.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.content
inputs.description: Required screen component rendered once its selected revision and parent context are ready.

outputs.name: HarnessConsole
outputs.description: Explorer header and selected screen, with loading, unavailable-address and missing-registry notices. Index and selected-revision failures become visible problem text; unavailable parent data becomes null.

errors.name: Host navigation or screen error
errors.description: Errors from navigate or the supplied content component propagate. Index/revision fetch failures become notices; missing parent/activity data falls back to null.

inputs.name: consoleContentKey.location
inputs.description: Required argument; undefined represents a screen not ready to render. The key includes branch, commit, category, screen, entity, helper and section, preserving content across tab changes.

outputs.name: consoleContentKey
outputs.description: JSON key of the selected route identity. Tab changes preserve it; undefined locations serialize as seven null entries.

inputs.name: consoleRelations.detail
inputs.description: Required selected revision whose registered units use their own dependency and consumer relationships.

inputs.name: consoleRelations.before
inputs.description: Required parent revision or null; removed units use parent relationships when available.

inputs.name: consoleRelations.listed
inputs.description: Required selected-revision entities used to resolve runtime owners and relationships.

outputs.name: consoleRelations
outputs.description: Resolver returning dependencies and consumers from the current revision, or the parent for a removed unit. Unknown ids retain the reader's explicit empty relationships.

inputs.name: consoleView.index
inputs.description: Required selected history index used for revision-bound history lookup.

inputs.name: consoleView.scope
inputs.description: Required route scope, canonicalized to the selected entity category and helper.

inputs.name: consoleView.loaded
inputs.description: Required matching head revision and its parent revision or null.

inputs.name: consoleView.entities
inputs.description: Required entities belonging to those loaded revisions.

inputs.name: consoleView.relations
inputs.description: Required revision-scoped relationship resolver retained by the returned lens.

inputs.name: consoleView.answers
inputs.description: Required caller-owned answer cache; missing evidence/behavior entries are populated lazily by the returned lens.

inputs.name: consoleView.href
inputs.description: Required address callback retained by the returned lens; called later by its consumers.

outputs.name: consoleView
outputs.type: { index: HarnessIndex; scope: ExplorerScope; head: HarnessRevision; parent: HarnessRevision | null; lens: EntityLens }
outputs.description: Canonical revision view and lazy evidence, behavior, relationships, address and history lens. Evidence/behavior share answers cached by unit id; callbacks retain their caller behavior.
